categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded after goods receipt
categories.description: Represents items where goods receipt occurs before the invoice is recorded, realizing the 3-way match control regime. This makes a strong positive contribution to value-matching control integrity and helps working-capital efficiency, measured against Indicator 17 (Time to clearance, 3-way after GR).
categories.rationale: This maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=5. The narrative sample shows frequent variants such as V0001 where Record Goods Receipt precedes Record Invoice Receipt, maintaining control integrity.

categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded before goods receipt
categories.description: Represents items where the invoice is recorded prior to goods receipt, helping working-capital efficiency while providing moderate support to control integrity. Judged against Indicator 18 (Time to clearance, 3-way before GR).
categories.rationale: This maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=6. The narrative sample shows variants such as V0006 and V0007 where the invoice creation or receipt precedes the goods receipt.

categories.name: 2-way matched (no goods receipt required)
categories.description: Represents invoice clearance without requiring a physical goods receipt, helping minimize procurement and matching overhead. Measured against Indicator 19 (Time to clearance, 2-way match).
categories.rationale: This maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=7, observing invoice clearance patterns that omit goods receipt tasks.

categories.name: Resolve via consignment consumption
categories.description: Resolves item closure through consignment consumption steps, minimizing procurement overhead and matching effort. Judged against Indicator 21 (Exception/rework rate).
categories.rationale: This maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=13, observed via service entry sheet and consignment settlement patterns in the log.
